primitives.name: Penalty Enforcement Position
primitives.verbatim_quote: Penalties for fouls committed by players shall be enforced from the spot where the foul was committed, even though it be behind the goal line, unless otherwise specified.
primitives.assumptions: Foul location is known and fixed; enforcement occurs at exact foul site.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When foul occurs behind goal line, enforcement remains valid.

layer2.mapping: Maps foul spatial coordinates to enforcement state in GSE transition graph.
layer2.telemetry: Observed foul location vs. enforcement point discrepancy.

primitives.name: First Down Adjustment
primitives.verbatim_quote: If a foul is committed by the First down side which did not put the ball in play, the when offending scrimmage after a distance penalty shall be side not in poscounted as first down with 10 yards to gain.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'d_penalty': 'distance penalty (yards)', 'd_needed': 'yards needed for first down (yards)', 'down_new': 'new down count (dimensionless)', 'yds_to_gain': 'yards to gain (yards)'}
primitives.assumptions: Foul affects only the current down and distance; no change in possession.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When penalty does not advance ball past required yardage.

layer2.mapping: Derives new down-and-distance state from penalty application in GSE.
layer2.telemetry: Change in down count and yards-to-gain post-foul.

primitives.name: Possession Transfer
primitives.verbatim_quote: If a foul is committed by a First down player when neither side is in possession of when neither the ball, the ball shall go to the offended side in possesside as first down at the point of the foul.
primitives.assumptions: No prior possession exists; foul triggers immediate transfer.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Upon foul committed without ball possession.

layer2.mapping: Maps foul event to possession shift in GSE state space.
layer2.telemetry: Ball possession change following foul enforcement.

Failure modes include misalignment between foul location and enforcement spot, or incorrect interpretation of possession status. The system exhibits robustness under normal play but may fail under ambiguous foul scenarios or inconsistent enforcement.
